archive_format.description: Default compression format identifier (e.g., lh1, lh4, lzs, pm1). Refer to COMPRESSION FORMATS in man page.

extraction_dest.description: Destination directory for extraction, corresponding to the 'w=<dir>' option.

quiet_level.description: Quiet mode level: 0 (normal), 1, or 2 (full suppression). Corresponds to 'q[num]' option.

force_overwrite.description: If true, enables the 'f' (force overwrite) option.

ignore_paths.description: If true, enables the 'i' (ignore paths) option.

dry_run.description: If true, enables the 'n' (dry run) option.

operations.description: List of archive operations to configure. Items schema defined below.
